LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.Intro: Trained and clever animals produce less filth, and hold it until they are outside the base.
LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.ObedientTip: Applies as soon as the animal has learned obedience.
LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.WellTrainedTip: Applies once the animal has learned at least one training beyond obedience (release, hauling, rescue…). Replaces the obedience value, it does not stack with it.
LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.AdvancedTip: Multiplies with the training reduction. A sentience catalyst raises trainability by one tier, so it counts here.
LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.ColonyOnlyTip: Leave wild animals and visitors' animals untouched.
LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.ManureOutdoorsTip: An animal already made cleaner by the settings above holds it while inside the base, and relieves itself once outside. Animals with no reduction at all are unaffected.
LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.WholeHomeAreaTip: Off: only roofed rooms of the home area count, so an unroofed pasture still gets manure. On: nothing is dropped anywhere in the home area.
LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.IndoorTip: At 100% the animal drops nothing at all indoors.
LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.OutdoorTip: At 200% by default, what was held inside comes back out rather than simply vanishing. Lower it to 100% if you would rather the colony just produce less filth overall. The right value depends on how much time your animals really spend outdoors.
LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.ExemptAlert: Exempt clean animals from the "animal filth" alert
LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.ExemptAlertTip: Any animal getting a reduction from this mod stops triggering the alert, however dirty it still is.
LanguageData.Housebroken.Settings.ConfirmReset: Restore every Housebroken setting to its default?
LanguageData.Housebroken.Stat.HoldingIt: Holding it inside the base: x{0}
